scope: Targeted static review of projects/issues/work items/assignment/hierarchy/relations/milestones/iterations and CE/EE shared create/update/state/widget/board/bulk/delete paths; title-description-only optimistic locking versus assignment, permission filtering and parent unique violation handling; native REST/GraphQL/MCP authority/scope/settings and typed write construction; representative token and workflow policies; native agent/workflow/parent/checkpoint/external identity and governance records, chain root SQL locking/caps, quota calls versus logging-only concurrent-session threshold, Redis workplan/turn/restart leases, new-session restart and selected resume configuration, status/stop/pipeline cancellation/stale cleanup/checkpoint activity and blob dedup versus append-only headers; workplan questions/content/generation distinction, tool approval, durable events/to-dos/history and best-effort audit/publication; selected merge lock/head/approval hooks, browser detail/error/board limit markup, dependencies/configuration/license. Selected model/service test assertion bodies read, not run. Not every-line or all EE extensions/custom roles/import-export/quick actions/merge strategies/CI scheduling/providers/Workhorse/AI Gateway and Workflow Service/chat/Cells-Geo/backup-restore/accessibility/performance/production concurrency certification.

lifecycle_review.create: WorkItem extends Issue creation and widget callbacks. Permission, build, filtered assignment and save callback transaction; secondary notes/hooks/triggers after save. Native workflow usage/access/precondition and chain admission are a separate lifecycle.
lifecycle_review.select: Namespace/project/IID and typed filters via REST/GraphQL/MCP; durable dependency links and hierarchy type/depth/confidentiality/self/ancestor validation. No execution-ready reservation in inspected issue protocol; dependency concern self/opposite checks are not graph-wide runnable DAG validation.
lifecycle_review.claim: IssueAssignee uniqueness is only issue/user pair; metadata permission and assignee visibility filtering. Issuable optimistic locking enabled for title/description changes, not assignee-only acquisition. Native session turn claim uses atomic Redis NX expiry with fixed workflow UUID and primary status recheck; not universal task attempt fencing. Workplan check/create within 2-minute named lease; flow-chain breadth/size under root SQL lock.
lifecycle_review.progress: Shared description/notes/assignment/state events, plan content, source links and workflow checkpoints/summaries. Common save callback transactions differ from post-save effects; bulk per-record permission and partial successes. Checkpoint blobs dedup while header append-on-replay; touch maintains stale discovery.
lifecycle_review.review: Typed status lifecycle checks, input/plan/tool approval states, locked session tool approvals and administrator policy. Workplan questions resolve separately without resuming. Plan generation completed describes session only, separate content write can fail. Merge lease/head SHA and EE approval recheck protect integration but do not gate every issue close.
lifecycle_review.complete: Issue opened-to-closed stores closure attribution; CE/EE close and custom-status paths do not universally check blockers/children/output acceptance. Native running-to-finished session transition distinct from issue outcome and does not enforce Rails-side accepted-child join; external flow graphs not certified. Iteration close and optional rollover separate from task acceptance.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Issue close/reopen/delete are planning operations. Native stop status queues pipeline cancellation, state machine signals stop after commit, worker invokes cancellable pipelines service. Not synchronous proof of external tool stop/side-effect reversal or revocation of generic project credentials.
lifecycle_review.recover: Native checkpoints plus activity timestamp and 30-minute stale created/running cleanup; waiting states retained. Failed/stopped restart acquires short lease then creates fresh linked session preserving original identity; new session prevents old workload writing into reused workflow record. Resume refreshes token/flow/environment configuration. No ordinary issue owner lease transfer or universal stale-attempt write fence. Workflow events durable queued/delivered and recipient-scoped to-dos permit later reads; publication/audit/email boundaries remain separate.
